title: Mark B Probable NDE 6518
content: I had already taken my prescribed Adderall earlier in the day. Later that night after work I took more drugs and smoked synthetic weed. I was fine and immediately just wigged out and had this crazy experience. I remember going super-fast, so fast my skin was burning off and then down a tunnel. At the end of the tunnel it was split, the top section was white and the bottom was red. There were voices saying, 'Choose' and I kept hesitating and they kept saying, 'Choose now! Choose now!' For some reason it took me forever to spit the name Jesus out but I said it like jeeeeeeeessssuuuuussss really long as I'm flying through this tunnel. After that, I went instantly to a better part of life. It was a life where everything seemed to be just perfect, where everything was revolving around me. Not long after that I became conscious and my one friend that was there told me I passed out and was rolling around on the floor, I rolled around so much I had scratches all over me. I have never had an experience like this. I have never had a near death feeling and never any dreams about Jesus himself.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He reported going 'super-fast' and that his 'skin was burning off.'

environment.environment_other_detail: After the tunnel, he described going 'instantly to a better part of life' where 'everything seemed to be just perfect' and 'everything was revolving around me.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug-related episode after taking prescribed Adderall plus additional drugs and smoking synthetic marijuana; he later learned he had passed out and rolled on the floor.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He described a split at the end of the tunnel (top white, bottom red) and voices saying 'Choose' / 'Choose now!' He then said 'Jesus' and 'went instantly to a better part of life,' then regained consciousness.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with voices demanding a choice at a split (white/red), then transition to a 'better part of life,' then awakening in physical reality.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: End of tunnel was split: 'the top section was white and the bottom was red'; voices demanded an immediate choice; after saying 'Jesus' he experienced a 'better part of life' where everything was perfect and revolved around him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Voices saying, 'Choose' ... 'Choose now! Choose now!' and he said 'jeeeeeeeessssuuuuussss'.
